t: A middle school science unit where students program micro:bit sensors.
steps: Find the Sensor Immersion unit page and download the materials.
Obtain micro:bit kits with the sound, soil moisture, and environmental sensors.
Plan for four or fewer students per micro:bit.
Open MakeCode in a browser and test it on student devices.
Check the cost of the kits. The page does not give it.
Set up the driving question board.
Assign each expert group one sensor.
